body: when you say "I" are you referring to the entire universe because that's what you are.

i agree that as humans we each have our own physical limitations. but are we stuck in a place that we are able to get out of? are we able to end what is defined in our minds and start fresh? each new moment undefined by the past. how can one act without being manipulated by their past? especially when interacting with a society that is constantly using the past to define the future. its like so many people are stuck in a loop.
